system.longDesc: While vac suits have the ability to use brief bursts of air to impart a limited amount of thrust, most standard environment suits do not. In either case, these thruster packs provide greater mobility and duration for travel in a vacuum. The total distance or duration available depends on how long each burst of air is (which also determines acceleration), but conservative use allows about two hours of continuous maneuvering. Thrusters are controlled by an on-board computer that calculates trajectories and use of reaction mass, making most short trips relatively safe and easy.
